reviews.text: Since Cristiano, Nicola, and Petru left, I've been having a hard time. They knew how to advise me, as I have a kitten with various gastric problems. I hope to see them again, otherwise I'll be forced to change products and store.
Thank you, Pasquale Vitale, for your valuable time and for the wonderful review! Come visit us again soon at Arcaplanet stores!

I'm writing this review not so much to leave a negative review, but rather to give food for thought, especially because I've been a customer of this store for almost two years and, until now, have always chosen it with great confidence.

As usual, I went to the Arcaplanet store in Furio Camillo, expecting to see Cristiano. Not seeing him, I simply asked for him, and from that moment on, I sensed a less than forthcoming attitude.

I explained that Cristiano was personally assisting me with a rather specific matter, which I had to explain repeatedly to try to make the situation clear. Despite this, I had the feeling that the staff present and I were speaking two completely different languages.

To avoid having too many people handle the same matter, which would also create further confusion for the company and the refunds I'm waiting for, I asked again when I could meet Cristiano, so I could meet him directly.

I was told that he has been transferred to another store. At that point, I simply asked several times where, because I would have preferred to reach him in person and continue to manage the situation with someone who had known it from the beginning. Unfortunately, I received no concrete answer.

Subsequently, I also asked about some kibble, and the answer was essentially limited to "none available," without any further information or alternatives.

And this is perhaps the aspect that left me most perplexed.

I've been frequenting Arcaplanet Furio Camillo for almost two years precisely because I found in Cristiano not just a person who sells pet products, but an extremely knowledgeable, helpful professional capable of offering expert advice.

When my two kittens arrived, it was my first experience, and honestly, I didn't even know where to start. Over the past two years, I've been able to ask him practically anything: diet, products, different brands, the kittens' needs. I've always received explanations, advice, and, above all, the peace of mind of knowing that there was someone truly knowledgeable on the other end. Advice that, incidentally, has always been appreciated by my trusted veterinarian.

It's also thanks to this that I've become a regular and loyal customer of the store.

Today, however, I left the store with a completely different feeling and some doubts about continuing to frequent it.

I believe that those who enter a pet store aren't just looking for a product on a shelf. Especially when you have animals to care for every day, you look for expertise, availability, a listening ear, and, when possible, even a certain amount of continuity.

I, like many other customers, and especially our puppies, need this too: continuity!

First of all, I hope that the situation regarding my case can be resolved as soon as possible. I will then evaluate whether to return to the store. But I doubt it!

I don't know where Cristiano has been moved, but they will certainly be very, very lucky customers.
Thank you, Anna Maria Palombella. We're delighted to hear your positive feedback about Arcaplanet! Thank you so much for your trust.

I go there because, just thinking about the games the cat plays all day, I'd buy her anything. Everything is available at a good price. There's also a collection for lonely and abandoned cats, which anyone can join anonymously.

A large pet shop located near the Furio Camillo stop on the A line of the metro. In addition to a wide selection of all types and prices of food and non-food items, you can also ask for professional opinions, who will provide you with a valid and well-reasoned answer... in short, a store you can trust and rely on with complete satisfaction: recommended.

March 27, 2022 - I confirm the review: the products and staff are definitely top-notch.
April 11, 2026 - The constant innovations in both the accessories department and the selection of ever-new, top-quality food products for all pets, combined with Cristiano's professionalism (not to mention Nicola and Pedro), have made this a constant point of reference over the years.

Keep up the good work 👏🏻

The staff is incredibly courteous, especially Cristiano, who is always ready to offer helpful suggestions and advice for the benefit of the customer and their pet.
The difference between the different locations is made by those who work at the individual stores.
Horrible service and truly rude clerks. I asked for help finding something and they told me to look for it myself. I'll never set foot in there again.

Even though the store appears to be participating in the Royal Canin Extra Small Puppy promotion, obtained from a breeder who sold me a Chihuahua puppy.
I was entitled to a free bag of food through a voucher, not only did this not happen, but they wasted my time both on the phone and in person.
The Royal Canin toll-free number is aware of everything.
I absolutely do not recommend Arca Planet in Furio Camillo or the one on Circonvallazione Appia. They couldn't even recommend a suitable harness for the puppy, which is an extra small size.
Luckily, I resolved the issue with another store, also in Rome, also because the voucher has an expiration date.
Aside from Arca Planet's incompetence, the rudeness is shocking. I've been dealing with dogs of all breeds for over 20 years, and nothing like this has ever happened.
A disgrace
Great shop for your four-legged best friend...
High prices, rude
We weren't allowed to see the cat section because the floor was wet even though it was well before closing time.

What can I say? Simply a guarantee, with competent, friendly, and kind staff!!!
A special thanks goes to Cristiano, always ready to recommend the right product for my furry friends and always with a smile on his face. I highly recommend them; they've become my go-to shop!

I love animals, I've had many over the years (hamster, cat, dog, bunny, parrot) and I've always only gone to Arcaplanet Furio Camillo because I had him nearby. Cristiano and his colleagues are fantastic people and above all knowledgeable about animals and what's best for them. I don't know what I'd do without them 🙏🏼🙏🏼😁😁😁 …

The staff is always friendly and knowledgeable.
Well done!
Kind and qualified staff

Well-stocked store.
Friendly, welcoming, and knowledgeable staff.
Cristiano, in particular, was incredibly helpful and friendly.
He has always helped me choose food (including medicated foods) for my pets.
Highly recommended for any need.

I have two dachshunds with varying characteristics. The store staff have often been very attentive and courteous in advising me on what to buy and what food to use for them. The store is truly well-stocked, and I've never left without finding what I needed.
Highly recommended 🔝

My favorite store, nothing else to say.
Cristiano, Nicola, and Petru, I think, are the best resources in the entire chain! …

A well-stocked shop, but the staff is absolutely rude and unhelpful, except for the older gentleman who is kind and knowledgeable and whistles calmly while he works. It's easy to avoid him since there are others around. It doesn't matter to you, and I don't want to ruin my mood by paying too much. Goodbye.
Courteous and knowledgeable staff
You can find excellent food

Friendly and knowledgeable staff.
The store is very large and offers a wide range of products to suit every need.
The prices...alas...are quite high, but unfortunately, it's hard to find these items at low prices; you pay for quality.
Good quality, always kind and helpful staff
